svg.title: Chromosome 7 in three matching views
svg.desc: Original editable vector artwork. One chromatid and two sister chromatids use the same 44 UCSC hg38 source intervals, stain values, per-chromatid widths and rounded outlines. Hollow purple centromere markers leave both lavender acen rows visible. Brackets show the q arm, q3 region and q31 band; the isotropic five-fold q31 crop has flat cut ends and shows white subband q31.2. CFTR cytoband location is approximate, not a precise molecular gene interval. Caps, necks and markers are schematic, not genomic spans. Source: https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/database/cytoBand.txt.gz.
svg.text: Chromosome 7: the same source bands in each view
A crop of the same chromosome
44 UCSC hg38 cytobands; approximate intervals. CFTR highlight marks a band, not its precise gene interval.
Rounded ends mark whole chromatids; cut ends mark a crop. Caps, necks and markers are schematic.
